payload.answer: Bring every line and branch under src/vibey to 100% branch coverage, and add a CI gate that covers ALL of src/vibey so no module can sit outside a floor again. Today four per-layer gates cover domain/, application/, infrastructure/ and cli/ and all four pass at 100%. Two modules sit outside every one of them and are therefore invisible to CI: src/vibey/tui/dashboard.py at 84% (23 uncovered statements, 15 partial branches) and src/vibey/bootstrap.py at 98% (2 statements, 2 partial branches, lines 279 and 501). The real total is 99%, not 100%. Close both gaps with genuine tests, then add a fifth gate: coverage report --include='src/vibey/*' --fail-under=100.
